name: pam_google_authenticator
detailed_description: Two-factor authentication module using Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP) generated by Google Authenticator or compatible applications. Provides an additional security layer beyond traditional password authentication. Requires users to enter a 6-digit code from their device.
notes:
Time-based one-time password (TOTP) for two-factor authentication
